definitions.target_present: An explicit, reviewable temporal target fits the six fields. Some interpretation details may remain unresolved.
definitions.general_or_atemporal: The expressed purpose lacks a temporal interpretation target. Dates may supply context without creating such a target.
definitions.underspecified: A temporal target is plausible, but unspecified anchors or criteria prevent fixing its requested scope.
definitions.image_dependent: Essential temporal target information must be recovered from an unavailable image.
definitions.representation_capacity: The original temporal target cannot be preserved within the frozen interpretation representation.
definitions.question_text_alone_fixes_interpretation: True requires only question-level interpretation, not a supplied answer. Null indicates that no temporal target was admitted.

span_convention.indexing: Zero-based Python Unicode code-point offsets into exact original query, including HTML. End offsets are exclusive.
span_convention.hash: SHA256 of UTF-8 encoded exact span.
